decisions.reason: The separate optional-tip transaction and its UI notice do not change allocation of the $15 primary-mint price.
The mint completed before the separate tip transaction, so the tipping-flow decision does not change the USDC mint requirement.
Optional tipping during a primary mint does not affect secondary-sale royalties or their enforcement.
The source describes a separate tip transaction after a completed mint but does not establish any change to Transak fiat purchasing or fulfillment.
The tipping transaction sequence does not change ETH conversion, exact-output swapping, refunding, or shortfall behavior.
The source does not change embedded-wallet provisioning, wallet assets, confirmations, or reward access for fiat buyers.
A notice about the separate tip transaction does not change which mint payment methods are enabled or how buyers select them.
The requested notice is tied to the tipping transaction UI; the source does not require adding or changing FAQ content.
The client only reports that the modal may have been hidden and does not change the rule that success feedback appears after an actual mint.
The tipping-flow notice does not require any change to the About page's project, mechanics, technology, or vision copy.
The missing commission and ticket count is an execution observation, not a client decision changing ticket issuance or lifecycle semantics.
The optional-tip transaction and its disclosure do not change Small Block funding, prize amount, winner count, or draw conditions.
